digest.component_or_area: Codex Gerrit REST credential guidance in AGENTS.md
propositions: AGENTS.md must instruct non-interactive Codex to obtain Gerrit /a/ REST credentials via git credential fill when a Git credential helper is configured.
A curl --netrc 401 should not be treated as proof that working Gerrit HTTPS credentials are invalid unless .netrc was explicitly configured.
The documented shell pattern must keep credentials in variables and never echo or log the password.
Existing git push and Gerrit gate guidance must remain unchanged.
test_codex_agent_guidance.py must assert the git credential fill, curl --netrc, false-401 explanation, and no-echo requirements.
